sentences.text: The current UCB rule that applies here is the residual rule: in cases other than the specific ones in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
The agreement copy states a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
The record does not include the UCB’s approved policy for pre-payment charges, so compliance with the current rule cannot be confirmed from the evidence provided.
The earlier RBI directions on pre-payment charges are no longer in force, so they do not control the current analysis.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB rule and the agreement copy; no approved policy document was provided.
